comparison.objective: Route a wire around formboard pins along a marked path and insert its plug; candidate tunes a rigid shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable cable routing, pin-side selection, tension management, and connector insertion versus rigid tool alignment, rotary adjustment, and force-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: Wire must pass every pin on the marked side and the plug be seated; candidate requires two safe impacts and witness-tested setting retention. Cable clearance and insertion-depth tolerances are unspecified.
comparison.reason: Deformable routing and terminal insertion test a different ability from rigid damper commissioning.
